notes.title: Xbox Controller Layout
notes.notes:
Y button to equip/unequip weapon, B to crouch, X to reload, A to jump, RT is left mouse click, LT is right mouse click, RB is peak right, LB is peak left, Press Right Thumbstick to use adrenalin syringe, Hold Left Thumbstick to run,
[b]Bottom Directional Pad button is flashlight, Left Directional Pad button is radar, Up Directional pad is for weapon, Right Directional Pad is lighter.[/b]
Menu button is escape key and Enter button is enter key.
